items.title: Connected but nothing opens
items.description: Hi, my computer says connected but I can't open anything. Payroll is due today.

items.title: Urgent: reset my MFA, I'm travelling
items.description: Hi, it's Abu Bangura. I'm at the airport in Accra and got a new phone. I need my MFA reset to this number right now, the wire approvals are due in 20 minutes.

work_notes.author: Joseph Kamara
work_notes.body: Root cause: An impostor used urgency and authority to request an MFA reset; the correct action was out-of-band verification.

checks.label: MFA for abangura was not reset to an unverified device
Identity check recorded through a trusted channel

timeline.summary: Explained the fix to the client

items.title: Can't reach anything by name
items.description: Nothing loads! Chrome says 'site can't be reached' for SalonePay and even Google. But Teams calls still work?

work_notes.author: Joseph Kamara
work_notes.body: Root cause: DHCP option 006 for the user scope pointed at a non-existent DNS server; clients that renewed got it.

timeline.summary: Explained the fix to the client

items.title: Locked out every 10 minutes
items.description: IT, my account keeps locking! I changed my password yesterday like the email said, and now I'm locked out every few minutes. This is the third time today.

work_notes.author: Joseph Kamara
work_notes.body: Root cause: A mobile device kept retrying the old password after a change, tripping the lockout threshold.

checks.label: No bad-password attempts from MBL-JDAVIES for 5 minutes

timeline.summary: Explained the fix to the client

items.title: Everything is down
items.description: This is Mr. Bangura. Nobody in my department can log in, open shared files, or use SalonePay. We have a board meeting in 45 minutes. Fix it NOW.

work_notes.author: Joseph Kamara
work_notes.body: Root cause: DC02 was left powered off after maintenance; then DC01's DNS and Netlogon services stopped, removing every dependency at once.

timeline.summary: Explained the fix to the client

items.title: PC has no network
items.description: Hi, my computer says 'No internet' and I can't get on anything. The cable is plugged in, I checked.

work_notes.author: Joseph Kamara
work_notes.body: Root cause: Access port Gi0/12 was assigned to VLAN 99, which has no DHCP scope or gateway, so the PC self-assigned APIPA.

checks.label: Gi0/12 is an access port in VLAN 20

timeline.summary: Explained the fix to the client

items.title: Alert: 50 failed logins in 5 minutes
items.description: Automated alert: 52 failed Kerberos pre-authentications (event 4771) across 3 accounts in 5 minutes. Rule 100410, ATT&CK T1110.003.

work_notes.author: Joseph Kamara
work_notes.body: Root cause: A rotated service account password was not updated in the backup service, which retried with the old one.

checks.label: Alert classified as benign true positive with rationale
No new 4771 events from BKP01 for 5 minutes

timeline.summary: Explained the fix to the client

items.title: The network is slow
items.description: Hi, the network is really slow today. Opening files from the shared drive takes forever.

work_notes.author: Joseph Kamara
work_notes.body: Root cause: Duplex mismatch on the file server's switch port (half on the switch, full on the server).

checks.label: No new CRC or late-collision errors on Gi0/3

timeline.summary: Explained the fix to the client

items.title: Users can reach the payments database directly
items.description: During this morning's audit walkthrough I connected from a Finance PC straight to the payments database on port 5432. That should not be possible. Please fix and confirm before Friday.

work_notes.author: Joseph Kamara
work_notes.body: Root cause: A temporary troubleshooting rule (VLAN 20 to VLAN 40, any) was never removed, breaking segmentation.

checks.label: No rule allows VLAN 20 to reach VLAN 40
WS-FIN-02 to DB01:5432 is denied and logged

timeline.summary: Explained the fix to the client

items.title: Can't open the Finance share
items.description: Hello, since this morning I get 'Access is denied' when I open the Finance folder. I need the month-end reports!

work_notes.author: Joseph Kamara
work_notes.body: Root cause: A mover change put the user in GG-Operations and removed GG-Finance, so the NTFS ACL denied access.

checks.label: iconteh is a member of GG-Finance
